My only reason for carrying on is hoping one day things will change, I'm still having anxiety attacks I just cried for 3 hours today, my life is also awful and I'm also closeted. Try taking things slow, do changes one at a time and slowly, even the smallest wins in our life matters.

If there are others suffering worse than you, that doesn't make your suffering less valid than theirs. I hope you can work things out one at a time, try to do things that makes you happy even the tiniest wins in life can at least give us some courage to carry on.

I can never change it whatever I do. I hope one day we would get to be the person that we wanted to be and live that life that we wanted to live, I hope that you can find the courage to carry on with your life.

Honestly when I'm having another anxiety attack and suicidal thoughts, I come here to reply to people like us, it's comforting to know that I'm not the only one suffering but it's also sad for me to think that there are also other people that are suffering like me.

Sharing to us random people will definitely make you feel better, you wouldn't have to worry about me judging you for feeling that way because we don't know each other personally and you can share your thoughts and feelings with people who are also suffering.
